snippet.title: puzzlez - a shapez game - Game Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist puzzlez on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4783760/puzzlez__a_shapez_game/

puzzlez - a shapez game is an easy to learn, hard to master puzzle game about building shapes in compact 3D spaces. Solve handcrafted puzzles with multiple solutions, from simple production chains to complex logistical problems. Design, share, and play custom puzzles with an ever-growing community.

Features
* Over 75 handcrafted 3D automation and logic puzzles.
* Puzzles ranging from simple problems to complex brain-twisters.
* Compact and atmospheric 3D visuals and a relaxing soundscape.
* Solve puzzles your way, track how well you did, and compare with others.
* Design, create and share your own puzzles using the built-in puzzle editor.
* Discover and play an ever-growing in-game library of community-made puzzles.
